reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept Format 1 SEARCH identifier-1 [VARYING {identifier-2 | index-name-1}] [AT END imperative-1] {WHEN condition-1 {imperative-2 | NEXT SENTENCE}}... [END-SEARCH] and Format 2 SEARCH ALL identifier-1 [AT END imperative-1] with exactly ONE WHEN {data-name-1 IS EQUAL TO/IS = {identifier-3 | literal-1 | arithmetic-expression-1} | condition-name-1} [AND ...]... {imperative-2 | NEXT SENTENCE} [END-SEARCH], and refuse every other shape (no WHEN, a second WHEN in Format 2, VARYING on SEARCH ALL, a NOT AT END or other phrase, AT END after WHEN, an empty or conditional imperative operand, a non-equality or OR-joined Format-2 condition, a literal VARYING operand); the witnesses cover the NEXT SENTENCE arm and the conditional-operand refusal only.

reader.notes: Both 1985 SEARCH formats are spelled by edition-free grammar rules that already encode Format 2's single WHEN and AT-END-only phrase; the binder and ProcedureFormatPass refuse every off-format shape probed. The one edition arm on the format path (a subscripted identifier-1, a 2023 introduction) is refused at 85 as the 1985 SR1 requires.

refuter.evidence: Rendered the PDF page (render-spec-page.py 354 --edition 1985): Format 2 prints WHEN {data-name-1 {IS EQUAL TO | IS =} {identifier-3 | literal-1 | arithmetic-expression-1} | condition-name-1} [AND {...}]... with no parentheses; §1985:VI.6.22.3 SR3 gives 'any conditional expression' to Format 1's condition-1 only. Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-002/sr_paren.cob: SEARCH ALL ENT WHEN (K1(IX) = "B") DISPLAY "HIT " K2(IX) END-SEARCH compiles clean and prints 'HIT 2' at --std 85 (and at --std 2023); sr_paren2.cob WHEN (K1(IX) = "B") AND (K2(IX) = 2) also prints 'HIT 2'. Inconsistently, sr_paren3.cob WHEN ((K1-B(IX))) is refused COBOL1757 with the false reason 'this operand is not a condition-name'. Code: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/Validation/SearchAllFormat2Rules.cs#TryPrimary unwraps `LPAREN condition RPAREN` silently; its own summary (TryConjuncts) says 'whether Format 2 admits parentheses at all is a question about its general format' and leaves it unanswered. Other forms probed behave: EQUAL without TO, IS EQUAL, condition-name AND, function identifier-3, Format 1 with a delimited conditional, IS NOT EQUAL refused, refmod key refused COBOL2024, K2 without K1 refused COBOL1965, EQUALS refused. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.22.2 'SEARCH ALL identifier-1 AT END imperative-statement-1'; OK §1985:VI.6.22.3 SR3 'In format 1, condition-1 may be any conditional expression'; OK §1985:VI.6.22.3 SR4. kb/Work: no note found (grep of SEARCH ALL notes for parenthes/unwrap).
